cases.intent: Patch a production Worker when live deployed source is newer than repository source
A connector can list/download Workers but corrupts multipart Worker uploads
Large Worker source is truncated by the model-facing connector response
Upstream mutation succeeds but immediate read-back is eventually consistent
A mutation returns a transport error after it may have committed
Use an aggregation layer in front of an existing remote MCP
Production Worker code-only patch should preserve bindings and configuration
Creator is working from a phone and an automated deployment path is difficult but possible
